sources.quote: This is a notice of the Presidential declaration of a major disaster for the State of California (FEMA-4856-DR), dated January 8, 2025, and related determinations. The declaration was issued January 8, 2025.
sources.searcher_note: Primary record: FEMA's batch notice printed Aug 19, 2025 carries the initial notice for the Jan 8, 2025 California fire declaration; summary says it covers declarations from October 2024 to January 2025.

sources.quote: approvals are taking more than a month, on average.
sources.searcher_note: Adjacent measure only: covers slower request-to-approval times for disaster declarations in 2025-26, citing an AP analysis; says nothing about Federal Register notice lag.

notes: No news, trade press, watchdog or agency source found that reports FEMA's lag between declaration and Federal Register notice, the 110-day median, or the 223-day wait for the California fires. The evidence found is the Federal Register itself: FEMA batch notices printed 2025-08-19 (two, covering Oct 2024-Jan 2025 and Jan-May 2025) and 2026-05-06 (Apr-Oct 2025), and a prompt SBA notice (2025-01-17) for FEMA-4856-DR. These are primary records, not coverage of the finding. Much coverage exists on a different step, slower presidential approval of declaration requests (AP analysis, PolitiFact, Brennan Center, Carnegie); that measures request-to-decision, not declaration-to-notice. federalregister.gov pages sit behind a bot wall, so govinfo.gov copies of the same FR documents were used; quotes checked against downloaded govinfo text (line breaks in the source).
